title: An action no module writes is refused by every reducer over a shared log
note: AUD-054, the remainder of AUD-046. The action registry separates another subsystem's action, which a reducer skips, from one no module writes, which it refuses. UA1: the one statement of the refusal. UA2 to UA10: each of the nine reducers that read past such an action. tests/test_unknown_actions.py holds each, with another subsystem's action as the control.

mutations.name: UA1_every_action_is_known
mutations.find:
if owner(ev.action) is not None:
        return None
mutations.rationale: the one statement of the refusal answers that every action is known, and every reducer reads past one no module writes

mutations.name: UA2_capability_reads_past_an_unknown_action
mutations.rationale: an action no module writes is read past by the capability ledger: a newer schema's grant or revocation is dropped, and the grants it folds are confidently incomplete (AUD-054)
